title: From justification; sweetness of the heart at peace
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): Ye whole heart stands as seasoned with heavenly peace's sweetness; even sensing remaining sin in ye flesh, he rejoices in ye Lord, knowing ye Savior took his sins and made satisfaction. — This stands as ye peace ye angels wished ye shepherds at Christ's birth. Whoever stands as truly illumined by word and Spirit and believes Christ acquired salvation by passion and death and applied it in baptism can have a tranquil conscience.
pass_b_english: This is the peace the angels wished the shepherds at Christ's birth. Whoever is truly illumined by word and Spirit and believes Christ acquired salvation by passion and death and applied it in baptism can have a tranquil conscience.
The whole heart is seasoned with heavenly peace's sweetness; even sensing remaining sin in the flesh, he rejoices in the Lord, knowing the Savior took his sins and made satisfaction.
source_text: Haec est pax quam Angeli Christo nato pastoribus optarunt. Qui vere illuminatus verbo et Spiritu credit Christum passione et morte salutem acquisivisse et per baptismum applicuisse, tranquilla conscientia esse potest. Totum cor dulcedine caelestis pacis conditum est; etiamsi reliquum peccatum in carne sentiat, in Domino laetatur, novit Servatorem peccata in se recepisse et satisfecisse.
